name: bento4
description: bento4 — MP4 format library and tools. Analyze, fragment, encrypt, and stream MP4 files. Includes mp4info, mp4fragment.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/axiomatic-systems/Bento4/releases/latest/download/Bento4-Linux-x86_64.zip && unzip -o Bento4-Linux-x86_64.zip && sudo mv Bento4-Linux-x86_64/bin/mp4info /usr/local/bin/ && rm -rf Bento4-Linux-x86_64*
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub releases or package manager.
